questions: Can I bring my own script?
Yes. Create a project, open the script editor, and add your story, characters, and dialogue before building the storyboard.
Can I change a single shot?
Open the shot in the workspace, edit its description, reference image, or dialogue, then regenerate that shot.
How do I choose a voice?
In the voice-over step, preview voices, enter your lines, and add the generated audio to the corresponding shot.
Where can I download my film?
Check the shot order on the episode timeline and export it. You can download the video once the export finishes.
